The current self-sufficiency baseline is 57–62% (depending on measurement), and the policy targets 70%, a real if modest uplift. The public-procurement mandate for 75% UK-sourced food is a concrete, funded mechanism — not merely aspirational — which passes the soft-verb threshold.
